label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Let customers see their own license
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds a customer overview, so buyers of your app can see plan, usage, seats and devices without a support ticket. Stripe and Paddle purchases now also handle refunds and cancellations.

items.title: Customer overview from the server
items.text: One call returns plan, status, dates, features, limits, usage per period, seats in use and devices for a license key. The same data is served on POST /overview, and expired licenses are included so customers can see they need to renew.

items.title: Ready-made customer portal
items.text: Drop the React component into your account page. It shows the overview and includes the device list, so customers can manage their devices themselves.

items.title: Stripe and Paddle refunds and cancellations
items.text: Next to Polar, you can take payments through Stripe or Paddle. A Stripe refund (charge.refunded) or an approved Paddle refund now revokes the license, and a Stripe subscription with cancel_at is treated as cancelled at the period end.

note: The demo cannot show Stripe or Paddle: they need your own accounts and webhooks, and they are tested with documented payloads, not yet with real accounts.
